description: Produced by the assembly stage from script.json + Prompt 3 motion choices + measured dialogue timings (burst alignment). All paths may be absolute or relative to the plan file.

music.description: Background music bed. Omitted = no music.

duration.description: Seconds of the file to use (from its beginning); null = to the end of the episode.

start.description: Timeline position (s) where this segment starts playing.

scenes.description: Scenes in story order. The renderer gives each scene exactly `duration` seconds of screen time.

dialogue_audio.description: This scene's dialogue MP3 (all of the scene's lines, in order). Placed at the scene's start time. Null = silent scene.

duration.description: Seconds on screen = the scene's measured dialogue span (burst-aligned).

focus.description: Optional speaker_tag the framing favors (reserved for crop-aware upgrade; renderer currently centers).

image.description: Scene still (portrait webp/png/jpg) that passed QA.

ken_burns.description: zin: zoom 1.0->1.35 center · zout: 1.35->1.0 center · panr/panl: fixed 1.25 zoom horizontal pan · static: fixed 1.1 zoom.

title: ToonForge motion plan — input to renderer/render.py (plan-driven Ken Burns assembly)
